propositions: Parallel multi-session writes to the tickets store cause wedging when compaction sweep mutates the worktree before git commit, leaving dirty state on worker death that blocks subsequent git merge and strands local commits
Tracked runtime markers (*/.archived, */.write.lock) committed in HEAD before gitignore patterns existed remain as tracked dirt in every status check and must be untracked idempotently

Compaction fold crashes between first worktree mutation and commit produce abandoned partial folds (renamed *.retired files, uncommitted snapshots) with no rollback mechanism; recovery requires an intent journal outside the worktree to detect and revert incomplete folds
Union merge reconvergence fails on both untracked-file collisions and tracked-file deletions/modifications during origin/tickets merge, orphaning local ticket commits without recovery path
Store-wide walks (fsck scan, compact-all sweep) must default to active tickets only and accept --include-archived to limit scan cost to the working set
Push-recovery non-fast-forward path lacks the same untracked-collision and tracked-deletion recovery as reconverge, leaving dirty state after failed pushes
